title: Add Privacy Notice and Terms to mozilla/legal-docs
body:
A few steps

- [ ] Finalize /terms and /privacy content (Brian from legal)
- [ ] Create a PR in https://github.com/mozilla/legal-docs adding docs (Cory/Wil/John)
- [ ] ~~Update deployment to use legal repo (Engineering)**~~

** So it turns out we _aren't_ automatically pulling things in from legal-docs in Test Pilot (still open https://github.com/mozilla/testpilot/issues/738). The agreement we made was that we'd have keep an up to date copy of the documents on legal-docs. I'll check to see if we can maintain this agreement for Screenshots (at least for launch)
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: Confirmed with Brian that we don't need to have this automatically pull out of the legal-docs repository, but should keep an up to date version of the terms/notice there. So we don't need the 3rd task in the bug opening.
